entries.question: Registration kaise kare
entries.answer:
KGMU mein OPD registration ke liye aap niche diye gaye tareekon mein se kisi ek ka chunav kar sakte hain:

**1. Online Appointment (ORS Portal):**
*   Website: [www.ors.gov.in](https://www.ors.gov.in) par jayein.
*   State mein 'Uttar Pradesh' aur Hospital mein 'KGMU' select karein.
*   'New Appointment' par click karke department, date aur time slot choose karein.
*   Patient ka vivaran (details) bharein aur ₹50 ka online bhugtan (payment) karein.
*   Appointment slip download kar lein.

**2. Mobile App:**
*   Aap **ABHA** ya **Health Care** app ka upyog karke bhi isi tarah se appointment book kar sakte hain.

**3. SMS Dwara:**
*   Apne mobile se **"APPOINTMENT <Patient Name>"** likhkar **8887019134** par SMS bhejein.

**4. On-Site (Walk-in) Registration:**
*   Aap seedhe KGMU ke registration counter par bhi ja sakte hain.
*   Iske liye aapke paas **Aadhaar Card** aur **Active Mobile Number** hona anivarya (mandatory) hai.
*   Counter par details dene ke baad aapke mobile par OTP aayega, jise verify karke aap ₹50 ka token lekar OPD slip prapt kar sakte hain.

**Dhyan dein:**
*   OPD registration ka samay subah 9:00 baje se dopehar 1:00 baje tak hota hai (shaniwar ko 12:00 baje tak).
*   Bheed se bachne ke liye **pre-booking** ki salah di jati hai.
*   Yadi aap shehar se bahar ke mareez hain, toh apne department se sambandhit **valid referral** zaroor saath layein.

*Main hoon KGMU AI Chatbot, jise Dr. Ayush Yadav ne banaya hai. Agar aapko koi medical samasya hai, toh kripya KGMU OPD mein doctor se paramarsh lein aur chat mein apni niji swasthya jankari ya Aadhaar number share na karein.*

entries.question: Eligibility kya kya honi chahiye mph course krne ke liye

*   **Medical Graduates:** MBBS, BDS, BAMS, BHMS, or BUMS.
*   **Allied Health/Science Graduates:** B.Sc. in Nursing, Physiotherapy, Occupational Therapy, or other relevant life sciences/health sciences.

entries.answer:

Yahan step-by-step process di gayi hai jo aapko follow karni hogi:

1.  **Notification Track Karein:** Jab KGMU ka admission portal khulta hai, toh sabse pehle **Information Brochure** (Prospectus) release hota hai. Ise aap [KGMU Admissions](https://www.kgmu.org/courses_admission.php) ya [Notice Board](https://kgmu.org/kgmu_notice_board.php) par check kar sakte hain.
2.  **Eligibility Confirm Karein:** Brochure download karke usme MPH course ke liye di gayi "Eligibility Criteria" ko dhyan se padhein ki aapki B.Sc. degree usme valid hai ya nahi (kuch courses mein subjects ka combination maangte hain).
3.  **Registration:** Jab portal khulega, toh aapko online registration karna hoga. Iske liye aapko apna mobile number, email ID, aur basic details fill karni hongi.
4.  **Documents Taiyaar Rakhein:** Admission process ke dauran aapko apne 10th, 12th, aur Graduation (B.Sc.) ki marksheets, aur certificates (jaise caste certificate, agar applicable ho) ki scanned copies ki zaroorat padegi.
5.  **Entrance Exam ki Taiyari:** KGMU ke adhikatar PG courses mein admission ek **Entrance Examination** ke zariye hota hai. Notification aane ke baad, uska syllabus check karein aur uske anusar apni taiyari shuru karein.

**Abhi aapke liye sabse best step ye hai:**
Aap apni graduation ki marksheets aur documents ko vyavasthit (organized) karke rakhein aur March 2026 ke baad se KGMU ki website ko regularly check karna shuru karein.

entries.answer:

KGMU aur Lucknow University dono alag-alag universities hain. Main **KGMU AI Chatbot** hoon, jo sirf KGMU se sambandhit jaankari dene ke liye banaya gaya hai.

*   **KGMU (King George's Medical University):** Ye medical aur health sciences ke courses (jaise MBBS, MD, MPH, Nursing, BDS, etc.) ke liye hai.
*   **Lucknow University:** Ye ek general university hai jahan Arts, Commerce, Science, Law, aur Management jaise subjects padhaye jaate hain.

Agar aap MPH (Master of Public Health) mein admission lena chahte hain, toh aapko **KGMU ki official website ([www.kgmu.org](https://www.kgmu.org))** par hi check karna hoga. Lucknow University mein MPH ka course alag ho sakta hai aur uska admission process bhi alag hoga.

entries.question: 2d echo test hota hai
entries.answer:
Yes, 2D Echo (Echocardiography) tests are conducted at KGMU. 

For cardiac investigations, you should visit the **LARI Cardiology Department**. 

Please note the following important information:
